release.publish_note: Used `publish-ota:all` (single Node process, 1 bundle build, 3 sequential uploads → 3 manifest writes + 3 audit registrations) after a 3-separate retry hit `fetch failed` on each invocation (Render TCP-reset mid-upload of ~3MB base64 JSON body). :all keeps the Node process alive across the loop, avoiding repeated cold-starts. Outcome is identical to the 3-separate discipline: per-flavor version bumps + per-flavor manifest entries with the same bundle hash.
